title: Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety

Remote - must be based in Brazil

At Platform Science, we’re working to connect everything that moves.

Founded in 2015, we are an open IoT platform that partners with innovative fleets, application developers, vehicle manufacturers, and equipment providers in the transportation industry to deliver revolutionary solutions to supply chain professionals across the globe.

Our employees are an engaging, diverse group of people who believe in the power of great ideas. We hire people with different experiences and perspectives to build a company culture that fuels growth through innovation. We value thoughtful actions and empathy for others. We approach challenges with resiliency and creativity, while encouraging transparency because, no matter our backgrounds or responsibilities, we are one team.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Software Engineering Manager to lead our Video Safety engineering team. This critical role involves overseeing the development and enhancement of our innovative video safety software product, designed to improve the safety of commercial truck drivers on the road. Our system utilizes in-cab dashcams to detect and report safety-critical events such as driver fatigue, close following, and lane departure warnings. These events are then reviewed by back-office administrators via a dedicated portal.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of high performance, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor and coach team members, providing regular feedback and supporting their professional growth and career development.
  • Implement and maintain high engineering standards, best practices, and processes across the team to ensure the delivery of robust, scalable, and reliable software.
  • Coordinate and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including product management, design, and other engineering teams, to align on goals and deliver integrated solutions, working with a global team spanning North America, Europe, and Latin America (Brazil).
  • Oversee the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Drive technical excellence and innovation, ensuring the team leverages appropriate technologies and architectural patterns.
  • Ensure the team's adherence to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining a focus on quality and user experience.
  • Act as a technical leader, providing guidance and expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS), backend development (Kotlin), and front-end technologies (React).
  • Champion a safety-first mindset within the engineering team, ensuring the product's features and performance directly contribute to safer driving practices.
  • Knowledge of Kotlin and Java

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree preferred.
  • Experience in software development in a leadership or management role.
  • Proven experience managing and leading high-performing software engineering teams.
  • Strong technical proficiency in cloud platforms, specifically AWS, including services like EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and others relevant to scalable applications.
  • Experience with front-end technologies, particularly React.
  • Demonstrated experience with scaled, high-availability systems.
  • Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile/Scrum) and best practices.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with a track record of leading with empathy, fostering a positive team environment, and effectively managing individual and team performance.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with video processing, computer vision, or IoT applications is a plus.
  • Advanced/Fluent english is mandatory - written and speaking

Desired Attributes

  • Strategic Thinker: Ability to understand the broader business context and translate it into technical strategies and team goals.
  • Result-Oriented: Drives for measurable results and holds the team accountable for commitments.
  • Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience.
  • Collaborative: A natural team player who builds strong relationships and fosters a cooperative work environment.
  • Passionate about Safety: Genuinely cares about the impact of our product on commercial truck driver safety.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

About the role

As a Java FullStack Architect/Tech Lead, you’ll drive the design and development of scalable low/no-code solutions, enabling safe and efficient developer forking flows. You’ll lead a skilled team, provide technical direction, and collaborate across functions to turn complex business needs into high-quality, maintainable systems. This role offers ownership, innovation, and the chance to shape impactful products in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

What you will do

  • Lead the architecture and development of low/no-code solutions to support safe and isolated developer forking flows;
  • Provide technical direction and mentorship to developers, fostering a culture of best practices and continuous improvement;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, product, design) to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions;
  • Ensure high-quality code through design reviews, code reviews, and adherence to best practices;
  • Create and maintain clear, comprehensive technical documentation;
  • Champion innovation and technical excellence while balancing delivery timelines and business goals.

Must Haves

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, with deep expertise in Java and Spring;
  • 3+ years of leadership experience (Tech Lead, Architect, or similar);
  • Experience with responsive web applications using JavaScript, Typescript, ReactJS, or similar;
  • Strong knowledge of architectural principles, system design, and distributed systems;
  • Experience in designing secure, multi-tenant, and scalable SaaS solutions;
  • Familiarity with microservices, event-driven architectures, and domain-driven design;
  • Hands-on experience with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containerization, cloud platforms);
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, able to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders;
  • Proven ability to deliver high-quality, scalable, and maintainable solutions in a fast-paced environment with clear delivery goals;

Nice to Have

Job description

Na Hitss, a inovação é o nosso combustível, a curiosidade é o nosso motor e o respeito pelo cliente é o nosso guia. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma cultura vibrante, onde a inovação é alimentada pela curiosidade incessante e onde o respeito pelo cliente permeia todas as nossas ações. Aqui, você terá a liberdade de explorar suas habilidades, colaborar com mentes brilhantes e transformar o futuro da tecnologia.

Se você está pronto para fazer parte de uma empresa que acredita que o talento é a chave para o sucesso, envie seu currículo e junte-se à nossa equipe.

Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e impulsionar juntos a próxima geração de soluções tecnológicas.

Venha ser um Hit!

Main responsibilities

  • Estabelecer um conjunto de práticas que garantem a integridade e a qualidade dos artefatos do projeto;
  • Planejar, acompanhar, controlar, apoiar a execução e o encerramento dos projetos;
  • Elaborar o cronograma, orçamento e plano de trabalho para o projeto;
  • Elaborar e controlar o escopo do projeto junto ao cliente;
  • Gerenciar a análise de riscos – riscos de desenvolvimento, disponibilidade de recursos e tecnologia;
  • Gerenciar e controlar as mudanças do projeto.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos necessários:

  • Ensino Superior Completo na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou Nível Superior em qualquer área de formação com pós-graduação da área de Tecnologia da Informação.
  • Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Projetos;
  • Conhecimento de diferentes metodologias como PMI (Project Management Institute), PRINCE2 (Projects IN Controlled Environments) e Agile;
  • Conhecimento em análise e gerenciamento de riscos, estimativa, planejamento e análise de decisões;

Requisitos desejáveis:

Possuir uma das certificações abaixo será um diferencial:

  • PMP (Project Management Professional);
  • CAPM (Certified Associate in Project Management);
  • PRINCE2;
  • Entre outas certificações reconhecidas internacionalmente.

title: Manipulador de Saneantes
description:
Job description


A OSID – Obras Sociais Irmã Dulce é uma das maiores instituições filantrópicas do país, com cerca de 5,6 milhões de procedimentos ambulatoriais por ano, na Bahia, a usuários do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), idosos, pessoas com deficiência e com deformidades craniofaciais, pessoas em situação de rua, usuários de substâncias psicoativas e crianças e adolescentes em situação de risco social.


A entidade conta com um perfil de serviços único no Brasil, distribuídos em 21 núcleos que prestam assistência à população de baixa renda nas áreas de Saúde, Assistência Social, Pesquisa Científica, Ensino em Saúde, Educação e na preservação e difusão da história de sua fundadora, Santa Dulce dos Pobres.



Main responsibilities



  • Dispensar saneantes via comunicado interno e/ou solicitação via MV;

  • Controlar temperatura do ambiente;

  • Auxiliar na realização de inventários periódicos dos produtos estocados;

  • Controlar saneantes segregando do estoque produtos vencidos e informando ao coordenador de setor produtos com vencimento próximo;

  • Realizar acuracidade diária dos produtos do estoque;

  • Conferir e controlar a entrada e saída de produtos do estoque;

  • Manter a ordem e limpeza das prateleiras, caixas plásticas, pallets, carrinhos, armários e estações de trabalho;

  • Coletar e separar diariamente as bombonas vazias de saneantes nos setores destino;

  • Realizar a limpeza de bombonas e almotolias;

  • Preenchimento diário de protocolos e ficha técnica de manipulação dos saneantes diluídos;

  • Preparar a etiqueta de cada produto diluído na central de diluição e rotular toda a produção;

  • Diluir e envasar os saneantes em almotolias e bombonas e entregar nos setores destino.



Requirements and skills



  • Ensino médio completo;

  • 06 meses de experiência em cargos similares.



Additional information



  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;

  • Vale transporte;

  • Alimentação no refeitório da empresa.

About Olly Olly

Ready to roll up your sleeves and help transform local marketing forever? At Olly Olly, we’re blending technology and real-world expertise to empower businesses across the U.S. like never before.

We believe small businesses are the backbone of our economy. That’s why we’re on a mission to provide them with tools, strategies, and insights that help them rank higher, generate high-quality leads, get calls and reviews, and, above all, grow sustainably, without the hassle.

The Olly Olly platform complements our hands-on service perfectly: it’s no-nonsense, easy-to-use software that helps local businesses streamline operations and contact management, drive leads, stabilize cash flow, and maximize revenue with minimal effort, so they can reclaim their time to focus on what they do best.

Our Vision

We aim to be the ultimate all-in-one platform for small business growth, allowing owners to manage every part of their business efficiently and effortlessly.

Our journey began as an agency, and we’ve already helped thousands of clients succeed. Now, we’re embracing an exciting new chapter: becoming a SaaS-first company. title: Coordenador comercial
description:
Coordenador Comercial – responsável por liderar a equipe de vendas, definir estratégias de mercado e alcançar metas de faturamento.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Coordenar a equipe de call center e atendimento multicanal (WhatsApp, Instagram, telefone, leads digitais).
  • Gerenciar o fluxo de atendimentos ativos e receptivos, garantindo qualidade e padronização no discurso comercial.
  • Realizar o atendimento de leads vindos de campanhas de tráfego pago e conduzir para conversão.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho e elaborar relatórios de produtividade e auditoria de resultados.
  • Desenvolver e implementar ações comerciais e campanhas para atração de novos pacientes.
  • Realizar treinamentos periódicos para alinhamento de scripts, técnicas de atendimento e postura comercial.
  • Apoiar o setor de marketing na integração entre ações digitais e atendimento humano.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia em call center, inside sales ou coordenação de equipes comerciais.
  • Conhecimento em captação de leads ativos e receptivos.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de atendimento (WhatsApp Business, CRMs, plataformas de call center).
  • Habilidade em análise de dados e elaboração de relatórios de performance.
  • Capacidade de liderança, organização e comunicação assertiva.
  • Desejável experiência em clínicas, hospitais ou segmento de saúde.
  • Tempo de experiência acima de 02 anos na área.

Sobre a empresa:

A empresa cuida da Saúde ocular das pessoas, com excelência técnica, acolhimento, tecnologia de ponta e valores justos. Tendo como visão ser o hospital oftalmológico mais confiável da Bahia, reconhecido pela tecnologia, acolhimento e resultados que transformam vidas. Tendo como valores proximidade, conhecimento e excelência com propósito.

Formação Acadêmica: Não informado
Salário: A combinar
Cargo: Coordenador comercial
Empresa: Desenvolver treinamento e consultoria
Ramo: Recursos Humanos/ Recrutamento e seleção

title: Supervisor Case Manager Long-term Care - Delaware
description:
Overview

Company : Highmark Inc.

Job Description : JOB SUMMARY

This job manages a team of Case Managers charged with promoting quality member outcomes to optimize member benefits and to promote effective use of resources for members enrolled in DSHP Plus LTSS. Provides direct oversight to Case Managers, meets all of the requirements of a Case Manager and be able to assist in the day to day responsibilities of a Case Manager as needed. This is a full time community based position requiring frequent travel within the assigned territory in Delaware.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of community based Case Managers.
  • Promote quality member outcomes to optimize member benefits and to promote effective use of resources.
  • Act as a role model to staff and assisting in the day to day activities as needed.
  • Ensure care is medically appropriate, high quality, and cost effective.
  • Conduct frequent ride-alongs and shadowing of Case Managers for hands on support, quality assurance, and to identify training opportunities.
  • Apply clinical knowledge to work with facilities and providers for care-coordination.
  • Participate in rounds with the Medical Director.
  • Review documentation and processes for consistent practice, and to identify opportunities for growth.
  • Initiate and implement process improvements.
  • Assist Case Managers in finding solutions to challenging situations and overcoming obstacles to meeting member’s needs.
  • Identify and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Suggest new approaches to complex problems.
  • Ensure all staff achieve the minimal qualification of their position through ongoing staff development, counsel, individual and group education.
  • Ensure direct reports meet process and documentation in order to be compliant with regulatory agencies, including but not limited to: NCQA, URAC, CMS, DOH, and DOL.
  • Develop and implement modifications to ensure appropriate distribution of workload in compliance with Delaware Case Manager caseload requirements.
  • Recruit, select, orient, evaluate, counsel, and develop performance improvement plans; promote and terminate per corporate policy; and encourage career development and support of staff.
  • Adhere to all company, State and Federal requirements related to privacy practices, HIPAA, and quality performance standards.
  • Perform other duties as assigned/requested.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Social Work or in health, human, or education services and 3 years of experience in long-term care, home health, hospice, public health, or assisted living

Or

  • Master’s degree in Social Work or in health, human, or education services and 1 year of experience in long-term care, home health, hospice, public health, or assisted living

Or

  • Registered Nurse or Licensed Practical Nurse and 2 years of experience in long-term care, home health, hospice, public health, or assisted living

Substitutions

  • Registered Nurse or Licensed Practical Nurse and 2 years of experience in long-term care, home health, hospice, public health, or assisted living in lieu of Bachelor's degree

Preferred

  • Two years of supervisory or managerial experience.
  • Certified Case Manager (CCM)
  • Licensed Bachelors Social Worker (LBSW)
  • Licensed Masters Social Worker (LMSW)
  • Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW)
  • Experience working with HIV/AIDS population
  • Experience working with behavioral health population
  • Experience working with developmental disabilities population
  • Two years in home clinical or case management experience
  • Medicare and Medicaid experience
  • Managed care experience

Skills

  • Leadership skills and be able to relate to all levels of management and staff as well as individuals external to the corporation
  • Leadership, collaboration, and motivational skills
  • Ability to multi task and perform in a fast paced, and often intense environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to analyze data, measure outcomes and develop action plans
  • Team player that possesses strong analytical and organizational skill
  • The ability to prioritize work demands and meet deadlines
  • Proficiency in PC-based word processing and database documentation (Word, Excel, Internet, Outlook)
  • Reliable transportation daily to be able to travel within assigned territory
  • Ability to meet regulatory deadlines.
  • Has a dedicated home work space used only for business purposes and is able to comply with all telecommuter policies
  • Experience in geriatric special needs, behavioral health, home health
  • Understanding of the importance of cultural competency in addressing targeted populations.
  • Experience with electronic documentation system(s)
  • Experience with cost neutrality and budgeting

Scope of Responsibility

Does this role supervise/manage other employees?

Yes

Work Environment

Is Travel Required?

Yes

  • Conhecimento de processos de desenvolvimento automotivo GPDS SPDS.

  • Idiomas: Inglês fluente é mandatório; Espanhol é desejável.
  • Diferenciais: Métodos Agile SCRUM e Experiência internacional.

Competências Comportamentais

Buscamos um(a) profissional que:

  • Demostre forte capacidade de trabalho em equipe.
  • Seja altamente organizado(a) e capaz de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades.
  • Tenha flexibilidade e agilidade para se adaptar aos desafios e ao ritmo de um ambiente dinâmico e global.

Empresa com +15 anos de experiência desenvolvendo software em 4 continentes, com sedes no Brasil e EUA. Descreve atuação em desenvolvimento de soluções digitais (web, mobile, BI, RPA, entre outros).

Remoto | 44h semanais

Essa posição envolve liderar e apoiar atividades estratégicas e holísticas relacionadas à definição, desenvolvimento e gestão de padrões de modelagem e arquitetura corporativa.

  • Arquiteto Corporativo Especialista com foco em liderar e apoiar atividades estratégicas relacionadas à definição, desenvolvimento e gestão de padrões de modelagem e arquitetura corporativa.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Atuar como líder na implementação e manutenção de uma arquitetura corporativa integrada, alinhando-a com os objetivos estratégicos da organização.
  • Trabalhar com as equipes de negócios e técnicas, promovendo sinergia e garantindo que os requisitos técnicos sejam incorporados nas soluções.
  • Apoiar o time de negócios no desenvolvimento de uma visão técnica robusta, facilitando a comunicação entre áreas e orientando na criação de representações técnicas (como o modelo C4).
  • Estabelecer e gerenciar padrões de modelagem para assegurar consistência e eficiência no desenvolvimento de soluções corporativas.
  • Identificar oportunidades para otimizar processos e soluções existentes, orientando a organização para a inovação e sustentabilidade tecnológica.
  • Estruturar e manter direcionadores estratégicos da Arquitetura Corporativa (Princípios, Metas e Objetivos estratégicos, Capacidades por produto).
  • Definir padrões de estudos para análise e desenvolvimento de soluções corporativas e atuar como guardião da aplicação desses padrões nas entregas da equipe.
  • Zelar pela padronização de roadmaps por superintendência, assegurando alinhamento estratégico e operacional.
  • Criar e manter roadmaps estratégicos que detalhem a evolução do portfólio de soluções corporativas, definindo transições do estado atual para o futuro, conforme a arquitetura de soluções.
  • Desenvolver entregáveis como padrões de estudos, roadmap evolutivo, mapa de capacidades com análise de calor e insights para novos estudos com base em deficiências ou necessidades de evolução.
  • Revisar e propor o Comitê e Fóruns de Negócios estratégicos.

Habilidades que Você Precisa Ter

  • Faculdade em área de TI (Ciências da Computação, Processamento de Dados, Análise de Sistemas, Inteligência Artificial, Business Analytics, Transformação Digital, outros relacionados).
  • Especialização ou pós-graduação em áreas relacionadas à TI.
  • Experiência em Arquitetura Corporativa.

description:
Overview

We are tech transformation specialists, uniting human expertise with AI to create scalable tech solutions.

With over 7.400 CI&Ters around the world, we’ve built partnerships with more than 1,000 clients during our 30 years of history. Artificial Intelligence is our reality.

Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma revolução impulsionada pela Inteligência Artificial! Estamos procurando uma pessoa líder com visão estratégica para coordenar a integração de soluções de IA a processos de desenvolvimento de soluções e produtos digitais.

Responsibilities

  • Estabelecer metas claras e padrões claros para a implementação de IA em diferentes ciclos de desenvolvimento de software (SDLC).
  • Assegurar que diretrizes e padrões sejam seguidos, garantindo conformidade com regulamentações internas e externas.
  • Coordenar fluxos de trabalho onde humanos e agentes de IA colaboram em paralelo, gerenciando dependências e lidando com exceções conforme necessário.
  • Compreender como agentes de IA operam, pontos fortes e modos de falha, comunicando-se de forma eficaz com perfis técnicos (menos profundidade e mais visão sistêmica).
  • Promover clima para ação, adaptando papéis, práticas e cerimônias para incluir contribuições de IA.
  • Estimular experimentação, integração contínua de novas tecnologias de IA no SDLC, garantindo que a equipe desenvolva suas habilidades constantemente.
  • Mediar a confiança nos artefatos gerados por AI, determinando onde são necessárias validações humanas.

Pré-Requisitos

  • Formação Acadêmica: graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Processos: experiência em mapeamento, definição e customização de processos de desenvolvimento.
  • Gestão: experiência em gerenciar o impacto de mudanças em processos, cuidando das comunicações e treinamentos que se fazem necessários.
  • Habilidades Analíticas e Técnicas: experiência em acompanhar e interpretar indicadores de performance, suportando a tomada de decisões que busquem otimização e eficiência.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: experiência em liderar equipes ágeis, multidisciplinares ou em funções que envolvam colaboração entre humanos e sistemas de IA.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em Sistemas Multiagentes: Conhecimento em construir e gerenciar sistemas que operam de forma colaborativa e eficiente.
  • Certificações em IA e Mapeamento de Processos: Certificações relevantes em IA e/ou definição/mapeamento de processos.
  • Adaptabilidade: Habilidade em lidar com mudanças, mesmo que frequentes, e evoluir com as necessidades da organização e do mercado.
  • Experiência em Ética e Compliance: Conhecimento sobre regulamentações relacionadas à privacidade de dados e práticas éticas na implementação de AI.

title: Gerente Administrativo & Operacional
description:
Descrição do cargo

Gerente Administrativo & Operacional na Solverh. Faixa salarial: R$5.536,00 por mês. Salário real baseado em competências e experiência; falar com o recrutador para saber mais.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS

  • Conduzir equipes administrativas e operacionais com o objetivo de assegurar o efetivo completo de mão de obra nos contratos sob sua gestão.
  • Planejar, organizar e monitorar o ciclo completo de gestão de pessoas: recrutamento, seleção, admissão, acompanhamento, desligamento e movimentações internas.
  • Apoiar a célula administrativa nas tratativas diárias que envolvem colaboradores, garantindo o cumprimento das rotinas de ponto, folha e obrigações trabalhistas.
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato entre a empresa e o cliente, compreendendo suas demandas e oferecendo soluções rápidas e eficazes (convocação de horas, uniformes, substituições e comportamento).
  • Conduzir processos de mobilização e desmobilização de contratos, incluindo abertura de filiais/unidades de apoio, contratação e treinamento de equipes, bem como encerramentos contratuais.
  • Gerir contratos de fornecedores de transporte, alimentação, medicina ocupacional e serviços de apoio operacional, assegurando qualidade e conformidade.
  • Acompanhar e gerir as filiais e unidades de apoio nos estados onde há operações.
  • Promover a qualidade dos serviços, a busca por resultados e a melhoria contínua, elaborando e implementando soluções para otimização operacional.
  • Monitorar, estimular e desenvolver a performance das equipes sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Atuar junto à Diretoria na análise de indicadores, resultados e planos de ação.

ATIVIDADES PERIÓDICAS

  • Diárias — Acompanhar rotinas administrativas (ponto, admissões, demissões, afastamentos e tratativas de folha).
  • Manter contato direto com clientes por telefone e e-mail para tratar demandas contratuais e operacionais.
  • Garantir substituições imediatas e correções em efetivo de pessoal.
  • Semanais — Reuniões de alinhamento com a célula administrativa e unidades de apoio.
  • Supervisão das demandas de EPI e uniformes.
  • Acompanhamento de indicadores de presença e produtividade.
  • Mensais — Reuniões com clientes e diretoria.
  • Auditoria de folha de pagamento e contratos de fornecedores.
  • Análise de turnover e absenteísmo.
  • Anuais — Participar de planejamentos estratégicos e ações de melhoria contínua.
  • Revisão de procedimentos operacionais e indicadores da área.

REQUISITOS DO CARGO

  • Escolaridade : Ensino superior completo em Administração, Logística, Gestão de Pessoas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência : Mínimo de 5 anos em cargos de gestão operacional ou administrativa.
  • Conhecimentos Necessários : Gestão de contratos e equipes distribuídas geograficamente; Rotinas trabalhistas e de folha de pagamento; Pacote Office intermediário.
  • Requisitos Complementares : Disponibilidade total para viagens e flexibilidade de horário.

COMPETÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS

  • Planejamento e organização operacional.
  • Gestão de indicadores e relatórios de performance.
  • Processos de recrutamento, admissão e desligamento.
  • Gestão de fornecedores e controle de contratos.
  • Conhecimento em legislação trabalhista e normas de segurança.

CONDIÇÕES DE TRABALHO

  • Trabalho majoritariamente administrativo, com visitas operacionais e viagens frequentes.
  • Exposição a ambientes de operação logística e administrativos.
  • Uso de telefone corporativo e notebook.
  • Eventual necessidade de atendimento a demandas fora do horário comercial.

  • Plano Odontológico: incluso

ADICIONAIS

title: Director, Product Design
description:
Overview

Omada Health is on a mission to inspire and engage people in lifelong health, one step at a time.

Job overview: As the Director, Product Design, you will be a pivotal leader within the product organization, responsible for driving our long-term design strategy and cultivating a world-class team dedicated to delivering exceptional user experiences. Reporting to the VP of Product, you will manage the product design team partnering with brand, product, engineering and clinical to ensure a consistent, intuitive, and high-quality experience for both consumers and care team members. Your role will involve collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, engineering, and marketing to align design efforts with broader business objectives. You will spearhead the development of scalable, repeatable design systems and guidelines, while your leadership will emphasize user-centered design, innovation, and compliance. With a focus on personalization for key member segments at various stages of their health journeys, you will ensure that our products drive higher engagement, retention, and outcomes. Your strategic leadership, impeccable design eye, and user-centric approach will be instrumental in guiding the UI/UX vision and its execution across all touchpoints, ultimately achieving measurable impacts on member delight and business success.

Applicants should submit a portfolio showcasing a proven track record in creating consumer-focused UX that solves complex design problems providing impact to customers and the business, ideally within a healthcare category.

Your Impact

  • Team Development and Mentorship: Provide coaching, mentorship, and career development for the product design team to maximize their impact and professional growth.
  • Design Excellence and Learning Culture: Champion best-in-class design practices and foster a culture of continuous learning to elevate design excellence.
  • User Experience and Interface Design: Oversee the development of user-centered design processes, including research and testing, and ensure consistent, appealing UI designs across platforms.
  • Design System: Develop and maintain a scalable design system.
  • Innovation: Encourage innovation through AI and emerging technologies to enhance the design process.
  • Strategic Hiring and Organizational Scaling: Implement strategic hiring practices, effective onboarding processes, and develop a robust organizational design to scale the design team.
  • Vision and Strategy Articulation: Craft and communicate a design strategy that aligns with product and business objectives, while also advocating for the role of design at the executive level
  • Strategic Decision-Making and Leadership: Apply strategic leadership and problem-solving skills to navigate complex challenges and align design efforts with long-term company goals.
  • Clear Expectations and Accountability: Set clear goals, roles, and responsibilities, and establish rhythms of accountability to maintain performance standards and a healthy team culture.
  • Collaboration and Influence: Lead cross-functional collaboration, leveraging influence and communication skills to drive change and align with company values across different departments.
  • Customer Insights: Partner with the user research and clinical teams to gather insights that inform design decisions (research is a partner, not a director report).
  • Compliance: Ensure compliance with accessibility standards and relevant regulations.

About you

  • A Bachelor’s degree in user experience, design, or other related field
  • You have 10+ years of experience in product design, turning complex problems into engaging design solutions
  • You have at least 5 years of experience managing and scaling teams larger than 5 ICs including principal and staff level designers, with a track record of scaling and developing high-performing teams.
  • You have a deep understanding of user-centered design processes and consumer-focused digital experiences
  • You have direct experience driving strategic business outcomes through design of apps, ideally within the health category
  • You possess exceptional strategic thinking and execution skills, capable of translating high-level vision into tactical plans while maintaining a focus on detail.
  • You are a seasoned leader with a strong ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • You are a proactive problem-solver with the ability to navigate complex cross functional challenges and drive clarity in ambiguous situations
  • Appreciation of standards; proven methods and tools to enforce brand identity and consistency across all projects
  • An ability to prioritize work in a fast paced environment and meet changing deadlines and priorities on multiple simultaneous projects
  • Demonstrated expertise in integrating AI, ML, or automation both in design workflows and shipped product experiences.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
  • Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
  • Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
  • Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.
  • Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health

Omada Health is a between-visit healthcare provider that addresses lifestyle and behavior change elements for individuals managing chronic conditions. Omada’s multi-condition platform treats diabetes, hypertension, prediabetes, musculoskeletal, and GLP-1 management. With insights from connected devices and AI-supported tools, Omada care teams deliver care that is rooted in evidence and unique to every member, unlocking results at scale. With more than a decade of experience and data, and 29 peer-reviewed publications showcasing clinical and economic proof points, Omada’s approach is designed to improve health outcomes and contain costs. Our customers include health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, health systems, and employers ranging from small businesses to Fortune 500s. At Omada, we aim to inspire and empower people to make lasting health changes on their own terms. For more information, visit: omadahealth.com

title: Principal Architect São Paulo, Brazil, Remote
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Your Career

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. The role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.

The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement:

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.

  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.

  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.

  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.

  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership:

  • Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.

  • Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and expand the scope of sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and areas where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.

  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

Internal Partnership and Development:

  • Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.

  • Solution Design: Develop detailed, scalable architectural designs addressing client needs using Articul8 products and third-party tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Education: Master’s or PhD in Computer Science or related fields preferred.

Professional Attributes

  • Problem Solving: Breaks down complex problems into manageable components and devises creative solutions with iterative refinement.

  • Project Management and Prioritization: Balances multiple projects, sets milestones, and monitors progress; allocates time efficiently between short- and long-term goals.
  • Critical Thinking: Evaluates assumptions, questions methodologies, and remains skeptical when interpreting results.
  • Curiosity and Continuous Learning: Maintains a proactive approach to learning and staying updated on related fields.
  • Emotional Intelligence and Intellectual Humility: Demonstrates empathy, resilience, adaptability, self-awareness, and collaboration.

Competitive salary and benefits package, along with:

  • Access to the latest technologies and tools
  • Regular social events and team-building activities

title: Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD
description:
Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD

Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD role at Trilogy.

This range is provided by Trilogy. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$200.00/hr - $200.00/hr

Overview

Ready to revolutionize education through AI? We are seeking a visionary product strategist to spearhead our Education vertical and champion a mission that matters: helping students learn more effectively through personalized instruction. This isn\'t about incremental improvements—it's about fundamentally reimagining how education works.

As our Head of Product Growth, you\'ll craft the strategic blueprint that unifies our educational offerings into a cohesive ecosystem. You\'ll author our definitive "Brain Lift" strategy document and translate it into actionable roadmaps that make our products work in harmony. This player-coach role requires you to dive deep into critical work while guiding a talented team of Product Owners toward measurable impact.

We\'re challenging the status quo of one-size-fits-all education by building a system rooted in learning science and AI that adapts to each student\'s unique needs. Our mission is proving that education can be simultaneously personalized and powerful.

This position diverges from conventional product leadership roles. Success here isn\'t measured by process management or delegation skills, but by your ability to drive tangible outcomes through first-principles thinking, analytical rigor, and unwavering determination.

Working directly with founders and leading a sharp team, your ultimate metric is straightforward: demonstrable evidence that your strategy has meaningfully enhanced student learning outcomes. If you\'re energized by accountability and eager to tackle education\'s most significant challenges, we should connect.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Craft and Evolve the Strategic Framework: Develop and continuously refine the comprehensive "Education Domain BrainLift"—a living strategic document that synthesizes team insights, market intelligence, and learning science into a unified vision guiding the entire vertical.
  • Orchestrate Portfolio Development: Transform strategic vision into an outcome-focused roadmap that coordinates all products within our ecosystem. You\'ll determine the strategic sequencing that maximizes compounding value and provides the "why" behind every initiative.
  • Lead Through Action and Mentorship: Serve as both strategist and practitioner—running your own rapid OODA (Observe-Orient-Decide-Act) loops on mission-critical objectives while elevating your team through thoughtful review and strategic guidance to ensure cohesive execution across the portfolio.

What You Won’t Be Doing

  • Functioning solely as a people manager. While leadership is essential, your value comes from strategic direction and execution standards, not administrative oversight of headcount and budgets.
  • Implementing predetermined strategies. You won\'t be executing someone else\'s vision—you\'ll be crafting the comprehensive strategy yourself, building it from first principles and ground-level insights.
  • Maintaining rigid, unchanging roadmaps. Your portfolio strategy will evolve continuously, incorporating weekly learnings and adapting to new discoveries from your team\'s work and your own investigations.
  • Managing disconnected feature development. Success isn\'t measured by feature quantity but by strategic outcomes that create synergy across products, breaking down silos to deliver unified educational experiences.

Basic Requirements

  • 6+ years in product leadership positions where you personally developed product vision and owned fundamental problem-solution hypotheses
  • Proven track record launching at least one successful product from conception to market—specifically a complete product (not just features) that reached external users and generated minimum $1M in revenue
  • Demonstrated proficiency integrating AI tools into your professional workflow (analysis, research, strategy development, information synthesis)

About LearnWith.AI

LearnWith.AI is an edtech startup that leverages AI and subject matter experts to cultivate a new way of learning. Our unique approach leverages 50+ years of learning science, cutting-edge data analytics and AI-powered coaching. In doing so, we can help students learn more, learn faster, and learn better - and have fun while doing it. We are a remote-first company that hires globally via Crossover.

Working with us

This is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $200 USD/hour, which equates to $400,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult for more details on this topic.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You''ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You''ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You''ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You''ll balance help desk tickets and prioritise them. You''ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you''re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You''ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You''ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you''re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it''s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone''s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You''re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We''re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will have a builder''s mindset, be a collaborative partner, influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity, demonstrate integrity and accountability, and have remote work experience.

We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a competitive PTO package and ownership in the company via equity.
  • The ability to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a company that removes barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity and inclusion.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our team is global, remote-first, and spans North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Please note, due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. Ledn offers a suite of lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. The core values guide us: act with integrity, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are building, innovating and changing financial services for the better.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to design, implement and manage our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. This role reports to the Director of IT. You will be customer-facing and the first line of support, owning the support experience for employees via tools like Slack and Jira. We are Mac-focused, you will troubleshoot, use the terminal, and manage enterprise macOS deployments. You will procure and deliver technology equipment and own onboarding and offboarding experiences. You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and improve knowledge bases. You will manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and Mac endpoint/mobile device management tools. You will contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools and automate busywork. You will manage incidents and balance tickets with project work in agile environments.

What You Bring to Ledn:

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.

  • Self-management and ability to scope projects and work across multiple teams; agile experience with Jira.

Nice to Haves:

  • Some familiarity with AWS; GAM and command-line tooling; Jamf and Okta certifications; Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership in a startup/tech environment, values-driven, empathetic, and collaborative.

Benefits

title: Staff Product Manager | Explore&Search
description:
Overview

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager in our Explore&Search Team in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The Consumer Experience team in Product & Technology is responsible for evolving our product towards providing a simple, engaging and delightful partner discoverability experience, helping users start and cultivate their wellbeing journey with Wellhub.

The Explore & Search team's goal is to evolve the Wellhub app's browsing and search journeys providing users with an increasingly intuitive experience for discovering our diverse range of partners and activities, showcasing Wellhub' value proposition in order to attract, engage, and retain subscribers.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Drive the product vision for providing a great partner discoverability experience for our Members and Subscribers.
  • Defined product requirements, actively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders within Wellhub to propose new product solutions as well as to continuously review and improve the current product functionality and performance;
  • Analyze and assess product opportunities to unlock better partner discoverability and value perception of Wellhub's network
  • Build, communicate and discuss your product vision with internal stakeholders;
  • Drive product planning, build and manage high quality roadmaps;
  • Work closely with data, product design, engineering, and data science teams to deliver well rounded, scalable and stunning product features;
  • Define goals, metrics, track, and report their progress;
  • Design and run user tests, qualitative surveys, and AB tests.
  • Analyze product data to generate insights and identify opportunities that range from the end user experience all the way to the Search & Recommendation APIs, from improving the way partners are showcased on the interface to rankings and models.
  • Work closely with the Technical Program Manager responsible for the APIs to ensure planning alignment and smooth product improvements cycles.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experience leading the product development of relevant consumer digital products, in close collaboration with engineering and design team members;
  • Hands on mindset, entrepreneurial and self-driven spirit with a great desire to make things happen;
  • Analytical and quantitative skills is a must, ability to use data and metrics to generate insights, iterate and improve the product;
  • Strong problem solving - be able to structure problems, prioritize and make pragmatic decisions in unstructured environments;
  • Capacity to identify and connect users needs and business needs, and develop effective ideas to meet them
  • Ability to analyze complex requirements and intricate user flows in order to translate them into simple, friendly and intuitive solutions – with attention to detail.
  • Ability to discuss high-level product decisions as well as technical details effectively when necessary
  • Experience with consumer facing digital products. Marketplace experience is a plus.
  • Experience in managing user facing products that integrate with machine learning APIs, search and recommender systems is a plus.
  • Previous experience in search and browsing product journeys is a plus.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in leading the product development of relevant consumer digital products is a mandatory requirement.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Privacy notice for Candidates (Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos).

Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. Ledn offers a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. Our team is a diverse group united by the conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's products can play a critical role in doing so. Our core values are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are building, innovating and revolutionizing financial services.

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code. You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You should be adaptable, a creative problem solver, and a motivated technologist who can work in a fast-moving, execution-oriented team.

This role reports to the Director of IT.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; working with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across media; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically; strong written communication.
  • Experience writing clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages.
  • Proficiency troubleshooting, terminal usage, and macOS enterprise management; procuring and delivering technology equipment; onboarding and offboarding employees.
  • Experience designing, testing, building and documenting programs, policies, tools; contributing improvements to existing knowledge bases.
  • Experience managing SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and Mac endpoint/mobile device management tools; owning IDP and SSO improvements (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Ability to manage incidents and outages, prioritize tickets, and work on projects across sprints in Jira; comfortable setting and pursuing own objectives aligned to team and company goals.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture-fit qualities: adaptability, resilience, collaborative leadership, integrity and accountability, remote work experience.

What We Value

We seek someone who has a builder mindset, can create, iterate, and scale IT practices; can influence across functions with empathy and clarity; and demonstrates integrity with confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting from day one.
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company through equity; remote-work opportunity up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven career and inclusive, diverse environment.

Additional Details

Location notes: Indaial, Santa Catarina, Brazil; Gaspar, Santa Catarina, Brazil; Brusque, Santa Catarina, Brazil. Ledn is remote-first and values global collaboration. No agencies or recruiters, and no unsolicited resumes.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role & Responsibilities

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You're comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You'll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you're experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You'll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs. Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack.

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit). You've used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort. Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications. Culture Fit: We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The ideal candidate will: Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices. Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity. Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts. Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day! We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment. This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Technical Product Support Engineer (Remote) in Latin America .

As a Technical Product Support Engineer, you will play a key role in delivering high-quality technical support for innovative connectivity and communication products. You will troubleshoot complex VoIP, SIP, and API issues, ensuring smooth operations and customer satisfaction. The role involves direct interaction with clients via chat, email, and calls, while collaborating closely with engineering and operations teams to resolve technical challenges. You will also contribute to improving internal processes and documentation, enhancing the overall customer experience. This remote position offers an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment while developing deep technical expertise and problem-solving skills.

Accountabilities

  • Troubleshoot VoIP/SIP calls, RTP packets, and T.38 Fax over IP using tools such as Wireshark and internal monitoring systems
  • Replicate and investigate API issues reported by customers using Postman, escalating complex cases to engineering teams
  • Run live packet captures from cloud servers via Linux terminal using Tshark to diagnose technical problems
  • Guide customers through setup, configuration, and technical inquiries related to connectivity and communication products
  • Monitor operational alerts efficiently and provide timely resolutions to maintain high service standards
  • Collaborate with peers and cross-functional teams to improve processes, documentation, and self-service resources

Requirements

  • Strong knowledge of SIP, RTP, T.38, and other Voice over IP and Fax over IP protocols
  • Experience in product support or technical support roles, preferably with VoIP or telephony technologies
  • Proficiency with Linux, terminal commands, and network troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark and Tshark
  • Familiarity with API technologies and tools like Postman for troubleshooting
  • Excellent communication, listening, and interpersonal skills to interact confidently with clients
  • Ability to multi-task, prioritize workload, and work independently in a remote environment
  • Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to assisting customers and resolving issues

Benefits

  • Remote work across Latin America with flexible schedule
  • Opportunity to work with innovative communication and connectivity technologies
  • Exposure to advanced troubleshooting tools and industry protocols
  • Collaboration with a skilled, distributed team of engineers and technical experts
  • Professional growth and skill development in technical support and product engineering

Jobgether AI Matching Process

Jobgether is a Talent Matching Platform that partners with companies worldwide to efficiently connect top talent with the right opportunities through AI-driven job matching.

When you apply, your profile goes through our AI-powered screening process designed to identify top talent efficiently and fairly.

Our AI evaluates your CV and LinkedIn profile thoroughly, analyzing your skills, experience, and achievements.

It compares your profile to the job's core requirements and past success factors to determine your match score.

Based on this analysis, the 3 candidates with the highest match are automatically shortlisted.

title: Database Support Engineer - EMEA
description:
Join to apply for the Database Support Engineer - EMEA role at TigerData (creators of TimescaleDB) .

TigerData, formerly Timescale, accelerates real-time insights with the fastest PostgreSQL platform designed for transactional, analytical, and agentic workloads. We are a globally distributed, remote-first team that values direct communication, accountability, and collaborative excellence.

TigerData is hiring a Database Support Engineer for our growing global team. The right candidates will provide deep technical support and interact with customers daily. You should have deep experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL is a strong plus) and be able to gain a detailed understanding of TimescaleDB quickly. A "+can do it" attitude and a focus on helping the user are essential.

This is a remote-first, full-time position with priority in Europe. It is a permanent weekday role with 5 days, 8-hour shifts from 8:00 am CEST to 5:00 pm CEST, Monday–Friday.

Be familiar with TimescaleDB! Sign up for the free trial and test it out before you apply.

Check out the tutorial here:

What You Will Do

  • Work with customers across topics from basic administration of TimescaleDB to deep consultative conversations around design, optimization, and implementation
  • Manage support cases from beginning to end
  • Develop and maintain close relationships with customers to help them be successful
  • Be curious, always willing to learn, and continually look for ways to improve our products, processes, and culture

What You Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or equivalent experience
  • Relational DB experience at scale: administration, data modeling, query optimization
  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL a strong plus)
  • Experience as a technical support professional with external customers
  • Strong aptitude to understand and learn new software products
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to express patience and empathy when troubleshooting complex technical concepts to a varied audience

Other Things That Will Help

  • Be familiar with TimescaleDB; download and test it out before you interview
  • Familiarity with cloud concepts and experience with AWS, GCP, and Azure
  • Experience with relational databases, NoSQL databases, and data modeling tools
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL, including best practices, Query Plan analysis, backup/restore, migrations
  • A strong sense of curiosity and willingness to learn as you go

Our Commitment

  • We respond to every applicant
  • We review applications fairly and objectively, and shortlist based on relevant skills and experience
  • We ensure clear and timely communication throughout your candidate journey
  • We maintain a rigorous interview process with a high bar, designed to give you the opportunity to meet various team members across our organization

About TigerData

TigerData, formerly Timescale, sets the standard as the fastest PostgreSQL platform for modern workloads. Trusted by more than 2,000 customers across 25+ countries and powering over 3 million active databases, we enable developers and organizations to build real-time, intelligent applications at scale. Backed by $180 million from top-tier investors, TigerData is building the new standard for data infrastructure, built on PostgreSQL.

We embrace diversity, curiosity, and collaboration. Our blog post: What It Takes to Thrive at TigerData explores our values.

What We Offer

  • Flexible PTO and comprehensive family leave
  • Fridays off in August
  • Fully remote opportunities globally
  • Stock options for long-term growth
  • Monthly WiFi stipend
  • Professional development and educational resources
  • Premium insurance options for you and your family (US-based employees)
